name: Scorching Desert, Outside Village
desc1: The rocky walls begin to angle off more sharply here, but still hang
desc2: down over the valley to give a sort of protection from the elements.
desc3: The hard-packed sand it extremely hot, making standing in any one
desc4: place for too long uncomfortable. Despite the whirling clouds of dust,
desc5: a village can be seen to the east, nestled between the valley walls
desc6: and shielded from at least part of the desert's relentless wrath.
